title: Bangladesh deploys paramilitary as unrest grows over Sheikh Hasina’s return

ai.summary: Bangladesh deployed paramilitary forces amid unrest following calls for ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's return, with violence including bomb blasts and arson attacks in 28 districts, leading to over 520 arrests and at least 37 Grameen Bank branches targeted.

facts.claim: Bangladesh deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops
facts.quote: Bangladesh deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops on Wednesday as talks of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina returning to the country triggered clashes, bomb blasts and arson attacks, Reuters reported.

facts.claim: Violence blamed on Awami League supporters
facts.quote: The violence has been blamed on the supporters of her banned Awami League party, Reuters reported.
Between November 1 and November 17, more than 520 persons were arrested for their alleged involvement in the unrest.
At least 37 branches and offices of Grameen Bank were also targeted in arson attacks or attempted fires since November 10, Reuters quoted the firm as saying.
